2610.13398.title: Towards the Roof of the World: NLP Progress in Tibetan Languages
2610.13398.paper_summary: Tibetan, spoken by some seven million people on and around the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, remains underrepresented in natural language processing (NLP). We present, to our knowledge, the first peer-reviewed systematic bibliometric survey of Tibetan NLP: 140 publications from 2004 to 2026 in the ACL Anthology and DBLP, annotated for venue type, research area, first-affiliation country, and resource release. Output has grown rapidly, with 84% of the publications appearing since 2018, and has expanded bottom-up along the NLP pipeline, from corpora and word segmentation through script, speech, and applications to large language models (LLMs). Researchers based in China first-authored 87% of the publications, which span all 25 represented research areas, whereas work from other countries concentrates on Classical Tibetan. We argue that this full-pipeline paradigm, realized under the compounded constraints of a complex script, dialectal diversity, and geographic remoteness, offers a reference model for other low-resource languages of the Global South. We also identify gaps in dialect coverage, responsible NLP, native and comparable evaluation, cross-community visibility, and resource release (only 29% of the publications release data, code, or models), and recommend open science, shared standards, and community participation for the LLM era.
2610.13398.paper_summary_zh: 藏語由約七百萬人在青海-西藏高原及其周邊地區使用，但在自然語言處理（NLP）領域中仍然代表性不足。我們提出了據我們所知的第一篇經過同行評審的藏語NLP系統文獻計量調查：涵蓋2004年至2026年期間在ACL文集和DBLP上發表的140篇出版物，並對其進行了會議類型、研究領域、第一所屬國家和資源發布的標註。產出快速增長，自2018年以來有84%的出版物出現，並且沿著NLP流程自下而上擴展，涵蓋了語料庫和詞語分割，通過腳本、語音以及大型語言模型（LLMs）的應用。來自中國的研究者首位作者佔87%的出版物，這些出版物涵蓋了所有25個研究領域，而其他國家的工作則集中於古典藏語。我們認為，這一完整流程範式在複雜腳本、方言多樣性和地理偏遠的複合約束下實現，為全球南方的其他低資源語言提供了一個參考模型。我們還識別了方言覆蓋、負責任的NLP、本土和可比評估、跨社區可見性以及資源發布（只有29%的出版物發布數據、代碼或模型）方面的空白，並建議在LLM時代推動開放科學、共享標準和社區參與。
